verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms DeepSeek is accessible via OpenRouter (comm-3, comm-13 reference using DeepSeek 'via OpenRouter'), and docs confirm OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API making third-party gateway integration easy. However, there is no evidence of first-party or documented availability on major clouds like AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or Azure AI. Missing for 10: confirmation of listings on Bedrock, Vertex, or Azure model catalogs, and any vendor statement about multi-cloud distribution partnerships.
